title: SF Board of Appeals No. 26-053: alteration permit at 280-282 Roosevelt Way; firewall parapet location and property-line encroachment
jurisdiction: City and County of San Francisco, California (comparative, non-Alberta)
code_edition: unknown if unstated; appellant cites a 1-hour fire-rated parapet requirement without an edition

facts.text: Notice of appeal: DBI issuance on 2026-08-21 of Alteration Permit No. 2026/08/17/6686 (renovate street facade third-floor balcony, finishes, doors and windows, roof deck, infill small 3ft x 5ft former stair area at the rear of the third floor) at 280-282 Roosevelt Way.
Hearing dates conflict in the packet: notice p.1 and DBI brief p.63 show 2026-10-07; briefing text p.2 shows 2026-10-28.
Appellant says a proposed 42-inch-high firewall parapet encroaches about 21 inches over the north property line onto the adjacent lot (appellant's claim).
Appellant says the sponsor's PDF (Exhibit 1, project drawings) omitted the side-elevation sheets and does not clearly mark the property line (appellant's claim).
Appellant says a building code requires a 1-hour fire-rated solid parapet wall (appellant's citation, not verified).

Appellant's preliminary statement says the Planning approval was based on an omission from the application of the firewall encroachment, and cites Planning Code Section 136(2)(G) calculations (appellant's characterization).
facts.locator: packet p.3 (appellant); p.4 (permit review record mentions Section 136)

facts.text: Planning Department brief defers to the DBI brief on the northern property-line improvements and addresses a roof-deck setback request from neighbors; it is shared with Appeal No. 26-056.
facts.locator: packet pp.56-61 (Planning brief; p.59 defers to DBI; p.61 setback)

facts.text: DBI brief: the plans 'did not clearly identify property lines by a legend symbol or notation'; it states the parapet at the north end of the second-floor deck 'should not have been approved' as located beyond the property line (DBI's position).
DBI brief states the permit was reviewed over the counter on 2026-08-21 and issued the same day, and that four other alteration permits are issued for the property.
Lot references are inconsistent: 'Block 2607 Lot 36' and 'Lot 282' (p.3) against 'Block 3607 Lot 36' and 'Lot 283' (pp.6-8); DBI brief gives Block/Lot 2607/036 (p.63).
